title: Record finite GNU-time source contract and readable retention inputs
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Records one independently AI-reviewed finite GNU time/glibc observer source subject and makes five existing retention source bodies readable through public UTF-8 interfaces. The observer selection now names startup/support objects, actual native registrations, loader assumptions, ENOEXEC boundary, inherited usage holders and exit-time FILE writing. It preserves missing/malformed/partial usage and supplies no early-seal authority.

The prospective non-PIE ET_EXEC/glibc-only choice is explicit. No installed `/usr/bin/time`, build, security profile, native environment or host setting was changed or qualified. Whole automatic-retention source contract remains incomplete. Source adoption was already delivered in #6715. 

## Task and overlap

Original source investigation: [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Frozen H25 benchmark: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Immediate predecessor: [PR #6715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6715).

User-assigned automatic-retention source contract closeout/source handoff. Base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. The native subject is Debian time 1.9-0.2 with glibc `ef321e23c20eebc6d6fb4044425c00e6df27b05f`, stock glibc CRT, six selected application/support units and matching libc/loader; compiler registration CRT objects and extra DSOs are excluded.

Reuse rather than replace #6317 archive/oracle (`336015471e4f1bb95998f293aa76823fe11e33d5`), #6339/#6346 known-close/primary sequencing, #6351 original caught-primary scope, and #6709 actual caller source (`24417a34746985dd110d70a42b2b863b96963c12`). #6711 is a negative bootstrap observation, not authority. #6370/#6373/#6369 and #6549 retain their conditional source scopes. Related exact heads and primary source URLs/hashes are in SOURCE-PINS.json.

The five `.txt` bodies in `research/h25-s03-retention-text-inputs` are **unchanged copies of already-public #6715 archive objects**, not new accepted implementations. Public text readers could not inspect the compressed archive; ORIGIN-MAP.json links the exact original paths/members/bytes/hashes. Copies came from retained matching originals without archive decoding. The sixth body requested by the consultation, historical_eligibility.py, was not established as an already-public source-map object and is explicitly not included.

## Validation

Source reasoning and exact byte/JSON/hash checks only. The distinct native review retained 49 indexed byte/hash checks and 68 local evidence pins. The compact public catalogue contains 52 primary-reference rows; this is a different catalogue from the original helper inventory. CONTRACT.json is byte-identical to the accepted 1708 B subject. The native export's eight files are independently technically reviewed; the adapter assessment finished **7.002453 seconds after its 09:12 UTC deadline**, with explicit retained correction and **no on-time gate credit**. Source acceptance had completed separately at 08:45:43 UTC. Failed export snapshots remain local, not silently rewritten.

The additional five reference bodies have parent-checked exact byte/mapping equality; no new scientific adoption is claimed. Native MANIFEST.json binds its source argument/config/reference files. ORIGIN-MAP.json binds the readable inputs. Raw private Pro prompts/responses, runtime records and financial ledgers are excluded. No VERIFY execution hook, project imports, unchanged control reruns, native/compiler/scientific/archive execution, kernel/process probes, resource fit, performance or kappa claim. Hosted status will be read for the actual submitted head. All physical preparation/review/publication/final-metadata costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO.

## Credit

Chris R / Clear1nsight; original H25 source/review owners and GNU time/glibc contributors. Substantial ChatGPT Pro/OpenAI Codex assistance and distinct GPT-6.1-sol Max source/adaptation review. New prose/metadata Apache-2.0; external source-specific GPL/LGPL rights and predecessor Apache/CPython notices remain intact. AI review is not human or proof-kernel verification.

## Open next questions

Resolve the exact remaining source-input inspection, including historical_eligibility.py and forwarding bindings. Then select the complete finite file-size/profile, genuine enclosing START/reservation/bill endpoints, owning-leaf archive/oracle/consumer error and K-termination amendments with inherited controls. The next original result is one connected guardian/C2/fork-only borrower/issuer/writer-seal/archive/readback/release implementation and independent complete R01-R11 SOURCE adoption. No standalone native contract, readable input, helper or PR closes it. Installed-native/current ownership, numerical fit and one-use execution admission remain later distinct gates. The closed timebox and stopped implementation dispatch are not reopened by this publication.
